Sam: Quick experiment idea: run a microtest for pricing calculator microcopy + FAQ clarity. Objective: drop incoming 'how did you compute this' tickets by 30% and surface webinar for 2k+ leads. Launch next Monday.

Ivy: Agree. Let's test two microcopy variants under the total: A) 'Illustrative estimate' B) 'Planning estimate (not invoice)'. See which reduces FAQ clicks.

Marco: Also test CTA placement: inline under summary vs sticky footer. Measure calc_submit and faq_help_click.

Leah: Routing thresholds: estimated_monthly >= 2000 -> tag:pricing_hot (notify sales@redwood.ai + #sales-pricing ping); 500-1999 -> tag:pricing_warm (auto-enroll webinar drip); <500 -> tag:pricing_cold. ops-bot can create hubspot mapping.

ops-bot: Routing rule created: name=pricing_calc_microtest_2026, conditions: estimated_monthly >= 2000 -> tag:pricing_hot; 500-1999 -> tag:pricing_warm; <500 -> tag:pricing_cold. webhook=http://hooks.redwood.ai/route_v9

Sam: Nice. Analytics events required: calc_open, calc_submit, estimated_monthly, microcopy_variant, cta_location, faq_help_click, webinar_cta_shown. Add property 'region' for EU vs US.

Ivy: Copy drafts in doc: https://docs.google.com/d/DEF. FAQ snippet: "How we estimate costs" -> "We multiply your input throughput by model token price, add a small SLO buffer, and apply illustrative discounts. Use as planning guidance"

Marco: Optimizely plan: 50/50 microcopy, 60/40 CTA placement (favor inline). Stop rules: min 600 submits OR p<0.01. Primary success: faq_help_click reduction; secondary: webinar_signup for 500-1999 band.

Leah: UX: for estimated_monthly > 1200 show 'Saving tips' microcopy (batching, cache, quantization). Also for EU show tooltip about data residency.

Jules: I'll update the landing webinar blurb to include a 1-line benchmark: "How customers cut token/unit cost by 2x while keeping latency." Two bullets: "Batching & caching wins" "Real-world percent savings".

Sam: Final items: Marco sets Optimizely, ops-bot wires routing, Ivy finalizes copy by EOD Fri, Leah QA on staging. Quick 15m sync Friday 9:00am PT to confirm. :rocket:
